snippet.title: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061390/Dohyo_Dreams_Rise_to_Yokozuna/

Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna is a narrative sumo RPG that blends first person combat, life simulation, and story rich exploration. Train, cook, bond with stablemates, and fight to rise to the pinnacle of sumo.

Developed by 
Gamer Mind Studios
